closed-selector-exception.title: Operating on a closed Selector
closed-selector-exception.short: Do not select with a Selector after closing it
closed-selector-exception.summary: ClosedSelectorException is thrown when an operation that requires an open Selector is attempted after the Selector has been closed.
closed-selector-exception.why: A closed Selector can no longer perform selection or registration work and cannot be reopened for reuse.
closed-selector-exception.tips: Give the Selector a clear lifetime and open a new Selector if selection is needed after the old one is closed.
